selection_rule: Choose the prefix-bias strength with most development continuations containing a visible whole surname form, breaking ties toward the weaker bias. Among amplifications with prose NLL increase <= 0.1 nat/token, choose the largest mean log name-family probability gain relative to the first five control names. If none qualify, report failure and evaluate the least-damaging one explicitly. Evaluate selected bias and amplification, unchanged baseline, and first-token-only bias at the selected strength on untouched test prompts/seeds. Do not retune on test outputs.
